# Addresses = true VAs (imageBase 0x400000). Every row is a FUNCTION START verified against the exe bytes
# by `npm run re:check` (int3/ret padding before, prologue at the address). Names are the campaign's labels
# from the cited registry rows — a convenience for reading decompiles, NEVER evidence on their own.
# Add a row only for a function a dig has byte-read; rename here when a registry row renames it.

# Init / world-grid objects — VERIFIED §7, §11 rows 1-3, §8 rows 70-74
